blocks.text: Photo studio interior design and custom furniture, 130 m²

parts.html: A 130 m² photo studio that we designed and delivered: interior design project, custom furniture, turnkey renovation and design supervision. The brief was to fit several shooting sets of very different character for photo and video into 130 m², and to work out the zoning and lighting for them.
The studio has a corridor, a reception area, a wardrobe room, a prep and makeup area, a themed Barbie room, a cyclorama room and a loft area with several photo sets.

The entrance area is done in a light milky beige. The reception desk has a rounded end, and behind it is a wall of horizontal slats with the logo. Next to it are a shaped wall panel with a smooth cutout and soft lighting, and a tall handleless cabinet. The corridor has narrow panels in brass frames and a full-length mirror, with dark gray carpet on the floor.
The makeup room has two makeup tables with bulb-framed mirrors and brass trim, a dress rack, upholstered poufs and a coffee table.

The loft area is built on contrasting textures: gray brick-look and concrete-look walls, an insert with a rusted metal effect, and dark vertical slats. The lighting is black track spotlights, neon signs and bulbs on red cords. Inside there are several setups: a leather sofa against the brick wall, a bed on a low wooden platform, and a corner with round mirrors, an armchair and a decorative fireplace surround. The sets are divided by heavy curtains and are shot separately.

The Barbie room is entirely pink: an upholstered bed, a glass-front cabinet with muntins, clouds below the ceiling, rainbow-colored hanging rails and a row of lamps along the wall. The cyclorama room is white, with ceiling-mounted spotlights, a folding screen and a rack for props.

We made custom furniture for the project: the reception desk with wall panels, the makeup tables, cabinets, pedestals, shelves, the bed and other pieces, all designed together with the interior to fit each set. We take photo studios, salons, offices and showrooms from concept to renovation; see the commercial interiors page for more.
